stem: When $\ce{H2O2}$ converts $\ce{Fe^{3+}}$ to $\ce{Fe^{2+}}$ and forms $\ce{O2}$, what role does peroxide have?

stem: What does III mean in the name iron(III) sulfate?

options.A: There are three iron ions per formula unit.
options.B: Each iron ion has oxidation number +3.
options.D: Each iron ion has oxidation number -3.
